description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:122-129 — de_static_str deserializes JSON strings by allocating a String and then Box::leak()ing it to produce a &'static str. The doc correctly warns 'In long-running services deserializing untrusted JSON, each unique string value grows process memory permanently.' However, the struct-level serde bound on EvaluationReport and LintResult does not mention this constraint anywhere visible to callers consuming these types via serde. The crate-level docs don't call out the memory growth risk either. A caller who rounds-trips thousands of EvaluationReport values from a database will silently leak memory. Fix: add a crate-level warning in the serde section and on EvaluationReport::deserialize pointing to the Box::leak behavior, and consider interning or switching LintResult/Finding to Cow fields instead of &'static str for the detail fields.
title: de_static_str leak unbounded in long-lived server use
